instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only shadow density. Set shadow density to: open, readable shadows with visible interior detail. Do not move the key light, do not change hue, do not add haze, and do not change optical sharpness.
hold_constant: Do not move the key light, do not change hue, do not add haze, and do not change optical sharpness.
